text:
incident-bot: [P1] Alert: Quality regression detected for tenant AcmeCorp on dedicated pool pool-d-42 after quant profile rollout v2.3. Signals: eval set BLEU down 18%, customer-reported hallucinations increased.

eliz_oncall: Paging @tanvi_ml and @mike_infra. I'm oncall, starting triage. Pinged customer-success for impact scoping.

tanvi_ml: On it. We're seeing token-level perplexity spike at ~step 240k in the profile rollout logs. Suspect aggressive quantization (8->4 bit mixed) on KV cache path.

mike_infra: Confirmed. pool-d-42 shows higher tail latencies but within SLA. No infra OOMs. Quantized kernels loaded at 08:23 UTC.

sarah_support: I'll open a support case for AcmeCorp and draft an interim message. They reported multiple bad responses in prod earlier.

ryan_eng: Any immediate mitigation? Can we route AcmeCorp off the quantized variant to a previous model build?

tanvi_ml: Yes. Recommend immediate revert to quant profile v2.2 for AcmeCorp only. Two options: 1) revert quant profile for their tenant (preferred) 2) route their requests to unquantized model variant (higher cost)

ops-runner: Revert plan: update tenant-routing rule -> assign quant_profile: v2.2 -> warm KV cache by replaying recent prefixes for hot tenants. ETA 12-15 mins.

eliz_oncall: Do it. @ops-runner proceed with tenant-scoped revert. Notify when traffic switch starts.

ops-runner: Starting revert now. Command:
```
redwoodctl tenants update acmecorp --quant-profile v2.2 --pool pool-d-42
```
Applying config -> pushing to proxies -> draining sessions pinned to v2.3

incident-bot: Action logged by eliz_oncall at 2505001242. Incident ID: INC-2505-AcmeRegress. Severity: P1 (tenant impact)

mike_infra: Proxy configs updated. New routing rule propagated to 6/6 edge nodes.

tanvi_ml: Rolling back weights and restoring KV cache checkpoint from 2504999000. This should reduce hallucinations and perplexity.

sarah_support: Draft to customer: "We're aware of degraded response quality for some requests. We're rolling back a recent performance profile for your workloads — you may see improved results within 15 minutes. We're monitoring and will follow up." Want legal or sales signoff?

jim_sales: I'll review. Keep it factual and avoid technical details. CC me on the message.

ops-runner: Traffic switch complete at 2505001360. 100% of AcmeCorp traffic now on quant_profile v2.2. Observability: sampling shows immediate reduction in perplexity for sample set.

tanvi_ml: Initial eval on staging queries: BLEU back within 3% of baseline. Running wider A/B now.

sarah_support: Sent message to AcmeCorp at 2505001402. They acknowledged, asking about rollback timeline and whether historical logs were affected.

eliz_oncall: Good. Next: follow-up action items:
- tanvi_ml: run full eval on customer prompt set over next 2 hours
- mike_infra: snapshot kernel metrics and KV cache hit rates
- ops-runner: prepare a canary for future quant rollouts that excludes enterprise tenants
- sarah_support: schedule customer sync after 1 hour

tanvi_ml: On it. Will post eval artifacts and a regression root cause doc shortly.

ryan_eng: Suggest adding an automated safety gate: require regression delta < X% on tenant-specified prompt sets before rollout.

eliz_oncall: Noted. Handoff to night oncall @ryan_eng at 2505003000. I'm wrapping up. Incident status: mitigated (tenant rolled back), monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2505-AcmeRegress marked mitigated by eliz_oncall at 2505003005. Follow-up ticket: TKT-3251 created for rollout safety gate and tenant isolation runbook.

sarah_support: I'll log the customer postmortem and keep them updated.

--- end thread ---
